query: SELECT uc.id, uc.userId, u.name as userName, u.email, uc.companyId, c.tradeName as companyName, uc.role, uc.isDefault FROM userCompanies uc LEFT JOIN users u ON uc.userId = u.id LEFT JOIN companies c ON uc.companyId = c.id ORDER BY uc.userId, uc.companyId;
